reply.text:
Welcome back to the iron. Sore after a long break is normal, and day 2 is usually the worst of it, so take it easy and don't panic.

I'd like to see what your program has lined up for day 2 before I say more. Let me pull it up. The app has nothing logged for a program yet, so I can't see a day 2 for you. Tell me what you did on day 1 and I'll help you judge how today should go.

If the soreness gets sharp, sits in one joint, or comes with swelling or numbness, that's one for a doctor or physio rather than me. For ordinary muscle soreness, keep moving lightly, keep the weights modest, and we'll build up from there.
